history.finding: Both scene-hour/campaign-time coupling and unconditional guest daylight advancement predate the October 20 mod merge.

limits: Legacy saves retain their stored day/hour when no independent elapsed value exists. Previously lost hours cannot be reconstructed.
The original corpus runs interpreter, clock and elapsed-time arithmetic with supplied player storage and omitted rendering/network callbacks. It does not replay an entire original campaign.
Scene-hour comparison uses a circular 0.00002-hour tolerance because original offset rounding can return 24.0 just below midnight.
The inspected zone-load disassembly is retained for further lifecycle auditing; complete native zone-transfer/save format equivalence is not established by this pass.
